headline: Luigi 🍝 Stalker Plea Deal 🍆😩
text: Luigi 🍝 Mangione's legal team 🧑‍⚖️💼 is meeting federal prosecutors 🏛️🍆 on Friday 📅 amid reports of a potential PLEA DEAL 🍆🤝 to drop those two federal stalking charges 😱 that each carry LIFE IN PRISON 🍆🔒. The accused CEO killer 🔫👔 of United Healthcare's Brian Thompson 🧔💼 is hoping to dodge the double jeopardy bullet 🎯🚫 and escape the state trial 🏛️🔥 that starts September 8th 📅. If Luigi 🍝 pleads guilty in federal court 🏛️🍆 it could trigger New York's double jeopardy protection 🛡️🚫 and leave Manhattan prosecutors 🍆😤 crying in their court coffee ☕😭. The defense 🧑‍⚖️ is arguing you can't try the same crime twice 🔄🚫 even though the feds and state are trying to run it like a legal double feature 🎬🍿. Meanwhile federal judge already threw out the murder-through-firearm charge 🔫🚫 that carried the death penalty ⚰️💀 so now it's just the stalking charges 🍆📱 that allege Luigi 🍝 crossed state lines 🗺️🚗 with electronic surveillance 📱🔍 to ice the CEO 🧊👔. The lawyers are keeping it tight-lipped 🤐🔒 about which charges are on the chopping block 🪓🍆 but if this plea deal 🍆🤝 goes through it could be a game changer 🎮🔄 for the state case that was supposed to start in September 📅 but might get the double jeopardy axe 🪓🚫. Legal experts say it's a 'live issue' 🔥😤 and the state judge will have to decide if the charges overlap enough to trigger the double jeopardy statute 📜🚫 while Manhattan prosecutors will argue their case is different enough to proceed 🏃‍♂️💨. Meanwhile the federal trial is scheduled for January 2027 📅 so Luigi 🍝 has time to cook up more legal strategies 🍳🧠 while everyone waits for the plea deal 🍆🤝 to either cook or get burned 🔥😤.
